faq_heading: Homes near Simon Cunningham Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Simon Cunningham Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Simon Cunningham Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Simon Cunningham Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Simon Cunningham Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 40 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,285,000, condos $456,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Simon Cunningham Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Simon Cunningham Elementary the median was 27 days on the market, closing at 96.9% of the list price, with 15% of sales above the list price for the 40 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Simon Cunningham Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are North Surrey Learning Centre (0.2 km south), SD 36 Alternate North Surrey LC (0.2 km south) and Education Services (Alternate) (0.3 km south-east).

Simon Cunningham Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 9380 140 St. It teaches grades K to 7. Programs listed: Early French Immersion.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Simon Cunningham Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Simon Cunningham Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Simon Cunningham Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Simon Cunningham Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 40 homes sold within 1 km of Simon Cunningham Elementary: 17 houses, 2 townhomes and 21 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $456,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Simon Cunningham Elementary

36 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Simon Cunningham Elementary in a straight line (22 elementary, 12 secondary, 2 other; 4 independent). The closest is North Surrey Learning Centre, 0.2 km away, and the farthest on this list is Kwantlen Park Secondary, 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Creekside Elementary (0.7 km); the nearest independent school is Honour Secondary School (2.2 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Kwantlen Park Secondary (2.7 km). Other elementary schools close by: Creekside Elementary (0.7 km south-west), Green Timbers Elementary (1.3 km south-east), Cindrich Elementary (1.4 km south-west), Lena Shaw Elementary (1.4 km north), A H P Matthew Elementary (1.5 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Creekside Elementary, 0.7 km south-west of Simon Cunningham Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Simon Cunningham Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Simon Cunningham Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Simon Cunningham Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median condo within 1 km of Simon Cunningham Elementary was $456,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Creekside Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.7 km south-west of Simon Cunningham Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
